title: Customer Support Response
description: Draft clear, empathetic customer support replies for common issues while staying within tone and policy constraints.
template:
Draft a customer support response for [ISSUE TYPE, e.g. "refund request" / "shipping delay" / "login problem" / "feature request"].

Customer message:
---
[PASTE CUSTOMER MESSAGE HERE]
---

Context and policy:
- [E.G. REFUNDS ARE ALLOWED WITHIN 14 DAYS]
- [E.G. ESCALATE PAYMENT ISSUES TO BILLING]

Tone: [EMPATHETIC / DIRECT / FRIENDLY / FORMAL]

Desired outcome: [E.G. RESOLVE WITHOUT ESCALATION / COLLECT MORE INFO / OFFER COMPENSATION]

Please provide:
1. A polished response ready to send
2. A short internal note explaining the resolution if needed
3. One alternative if the issue needs escalation instead
example:
Draft a customer support response for a refund request.

Customer message:
---
Hi, my order arrived damaged and I need a refund ASAP.
---

Context and policy:
- Refunds are allowed within 14 days with photo proof
- Escalate payment issues to billing

Tone: EMPATHETIC

Desired outcome: RESOLVE WITHOUT ESCALATION

Please provide:
1. A polished response ready to send
2. A short internal note explaining the resolution if needed
3. One alternative if the issue needs escalation instead
tips: Acknowledge the emotion before explaining the policy
Repeat the customer's issue in your own words to show understanding
Give one clear next step and a timeline when possible
